QUOTE: Polls an `int*` cancel flag every 10 ms and raises an `std::atomic<bool>` for the backend ... The C ABI forces the `int*` shape

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer describes the poller bridging an int* to an atomic<bool> and notes the C ABI forces int*, but it presents this as a data-race gap rather than stating that the observer thread exists to bridge an atomic into a plain int because the C ABI can't carry an atomic. The direction and rationale are reversed or unstated.
